content.text:
Existing PID file found during start.
Removing/clearing stale PID file.
Tomcat started.
api restarting at 10:46:27

observation.command:
echo 'export XPLAN_JDBC_URL=jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/xplanbox' >> /etc/xplanbox.env
unset CATALINA_PID
/opt/tomcat-api/bin/shutdown.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 8
for p in $(ps aux | grep "[c]atalina.base=/opt/tomcat-api" | awk '{print $2}'); do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null; done; sleep 4
rm -rf /opt/tomcat-api/webapps/xplan-*
source /etc/xplanbox.env
CATALINA_PID=/opt/tomcat-api/tomcat.pid /opt/tomcat-api/bin/startup.sh
echo "api restarting at $(date +%H:%M:%S)"
